bullets.title: INTC: -25% premarket on PC collapse; multiple downgrades, PT cuts to $70-$100
bullets.body: Intel's Q4 guide of $15-16B was well below Street's $17B, driven by PC TAM declining ~12% in CY26 and ~10% in CY27, compounded by a $300M Fab 28 Israel explosion impact on both Q4 and Q1. DCAI surged +78% YoY but is supply-constrained; gross margin guided to ~38% in Q4 (down 610bps QoQ). Downgrades from BofA (neutral, PT $100 from $145), Seaport (neutral from buy), and Roth (neutral, PT $70 from $120); Citi keeps Buy but cuts PT to $100; MS cuts PT to $75; Wolfe keeps Peer Perform.

bullets.title: SNDK: Strong beat-and-raise; AI NAND demand visible through FY30; 8:1 split Nov 19
bullets.body: SanDisk reported Sept-Q revenue of $11.03B (+23% QoQ, beat vs. $10.72B guide midpoint) and EPS $49.51 vs. $46.67 consensus; gross margins 85.1% beat guidance. FY2Q27 guided to $12.4B (+12% QoQ) with GMs 84.5-85.5%. ~50% of FY27 bits and ~67% of FY28 bits are already under NBM contracts, with the pipeline exceeding available supply through end of decade. Citi maintains Buy at $2,100 PT; Mizuho reiterates Outperform at $1,900; 8-for-1 stock split effective Nov 19.

bullets.title: AMZN: AWS beat overshadowed by $77B capex, retail/ad misses, FCF burn; PT cuts to $285-$370
bullets.body: AWS grew 39% YoY (below buyside's 42-43% bogey) but backlog surged to $578B (+$82B QoQ). Management guided AWS >40% growth in 2027-2028 with a $1T revenue target. Capex hit $77B vs. $59B consensus; FCF burn widened to ~$42B TTM; Q4 OI guided $28.5-33.5B vs. $30B consensus. Advertising missed (~$19.6B vs. $20.8B est). Goldman maintains Buy, cuts PT to $370 from $375; Mizuho raises PT to $335; Opco cuts PT to $285; MS upgrades to $335 PT.

bullets.title: RDDT: -17-20% on Google Search cliff; logged-in transition key debate; PT cuts
bullets.body: Reddit's Q3 ad revenue grew +54% YoY with solid EPS, but Google AI Mode is driving ~1M/week search referral losses sustained into Q4, risking low-double-digit DAU declines. Logged-in users represent >80% of monetization and are 5x more engaged. Citi maintains Buy, cuts PT to $186; Raymond James keeps Strong Buy at $150 PT; Opco downgrades to Perform; OPCO's RDDT PT cut to track logged-out traffic collapse.

bullets.title: DASH: Acquiring CART for $17B; 3Q beat; Citi Buy $255 PT
bullets.body: DoorDash reported core orders +17% YoY with U.S. restaurant GOV posting fastest growth in five years; GnR GOV growing at 2x restaurants (~30-40% YoY). The $17B ($65/share) Instacart acquisition (~11x/10x 2027/2028 EBITDA pre-synergies) is expected to close 2H27/1H28 and accelerate the GnR business by years. Citi reiterates Buy at $255 PT; MS estimates deal accretive to DASH 2028 EPS before synergies; Wedbush upgrades DASH to Outperform at $230 PT.

bullets.title: RBLX: -15.9% on Q4 guide miss; AI game creation inflecting but monetization lagging
bullets.body: Roblox Q3 bookings of $1.70B beat FS $1.63B, but Q4 bookings guided $1.89-2.0B vs. Street $2.00B; Q4 adj. EBITDA guided ($70M)-($10M) vs. Street +$414M due to AI infrastructure spend. DAUs of 138M beat but hours engaged fell 14.1% YoY. Roth maintains Buy at $54 PT expecting near-term headwinds for 2-3 quarters.

bullets.title: PINS: Q3 revenue miss, Q4 guide light; PT cuts to $25
bullets.body: Pinterest Q3 revenue missed consensus and Q4 guidance came in below expectations despite 10% MAU growth YoY. European ARPU declined 8% on tariff headwinds and sales team reboot. Opco cuts PT to $25 from $30; Mizuho cuts PT to $25 from $32 maintaining Outperform; OPCO also reduces estimates on EU ad trend weakness.

bullets.title: EQIX & DLR: Strong Q3 data center REITs; UBS bullish into 2027
bullets.body: Equinix delivered in-line revenues with EBITDA/AFFO upside, raised guidance, and showed accelerating bookings and pricing uplift; UBS sees consensus upside through 2027. Digital Realty reported record Q3 bookings of $627M (44% of 0-1MW AI-related), raised FY26 Core FFO/share guidance to $8.30-$8.35 (~13% YoY growth), and expanded future development capacity to ~10GW. MS maintains Equal-weight on DLR at $215 PT citing $590M equity dilution risk in 2027, preferring EQIX OW.

bullets.title: AAPL: BofA removes from US 1 List; iPhone Duo demand strong per Foxconn
bullets.body: Bank of America removed Apple from its US 1 List while maintaining a Buy rating. Foxconn raised iPhone Duo production orders 30% and expressed confidence in demand; iPhone Pro/Pro Max wait times trending stable to lower WoW. Hedgeye signals AAPL in bullish trend (buy range $339-$353).

bullets.title: META: Bearish Hedgeye signal; UK CMA opens investigation into commercial terms
bullets.body: Hedgeye shifted META to bearish TREND with sell range $581-$652. Separately, the UK's CMA opened an investigation into Meta's commercial terms with news publishers and content businesses. UBS 3Q26 earnings brief noted META actual EPS growth +3.8% vs. -6.9% expected — a beat but stock still under pressure in the broader tech selloff.

bullets.title: MSFT: $25B bond issuance; bullish Hedgeye signal; 3Q EPS beat +18.3%
bullets.body: Microsoft issued $25B in bonds (first deal since 2017) to fund AI infrastructure, signaling a shift to external financing. UBS noted MSFT 3Q26 actual EPS growth of +18.3% vs. +14.4% expected — the cleanest large-cap tech print. Hedgeye maintains MSFT in bullish trend (buy range $519-$538).

bullets.title: NVDA: Hedgeye shifts to bearish; in talks to guarantee Anthropic data center debt
bullets.body: Hedgeye shifted NVDA to bearish TREND with sell range $205-$221. Separately, NVIDIA is reportedly in talks to guarantee billions in Nscale debt for an Anthropic data center, raising circular AI financing concerns among analysts.

bullets.title: MRVL/LITE: Deal speculation intensifies; arbs pricing ~30% premium, 12-15 month timeline
bullets.body: Market is pricing ~30% premium into the Marvell-Lumentum deal with arbitrageurs expecting a 12-15 month timeline for China/antitrust approvals. LITE is sold out through 2029 growing 40-60% annually with laser ASPs holding firm, raising management-level questions about why to sell now. COHR broadly viewed as a loser; GOOG or NVDA flagged as potential third-party bidders. JPM buyside sentiment: COHR -1/5 (bearish).

bullets.title: SPOT: AI music remix service and $4-5/mo AI tier launching Q1 2027
bullets.body: Spotify is planning an AI music remix service launching early 2027 and an AI tier priced at $4-5/month in Q1 2027, with UMG artists opting in at significant rates per JPM. Roth Capital is conducting a marketing survey on Spotify's pricing power and churn dynamics vs. Amazon Music and Apple Music.

bullets.title: FSLR: 2.7GW Q3 bookings; US ASPs 36c/W slightly below consensus; Buy $300 PT
bullets.body: First Solar delivered 2.7GW of bookings in Q3 with US ASPs at 36c/W vs. consensus 37.3c/W. Morgan Stanley notes FSLR is slower to book 2028/2029 shipments but could accelerate with higher pricing. Roth maintains Buy at $300 PT at 6x 2027 EBITDA.

bullets.title: TSLA: Hedgeye bullish trend; buy range $371-$415
bullets.body: Hedgeye maintains Tesla in bullish TREND with buy range $371-$415, one of the few large-cap tech names with a positive signal amid the broad Nasdaq selloff.

bullets.title: NOW/HUBS: KeyBanc cautious on ServiceNow AI timing; HUBS OW $285 PT
bullets.body: KeyBanc flags ServiceNow core revenue growth slowing despite $15B+ base, with AI consumption monetization taking longer to materialize than expected. HubSpot rated Overweight at $285 PT with focus on stabilization before AI monetization. Earnings due next week: HUBS Nov 4 (est. $3.27 EPS, $925.5M revenue), AMD Nov 3 (est. $1.95 EPS), ANET Nov 3 (est. $1.08 EPS), AAPL Nov 2 (est. $1.99 EPS, $113.4B revenue).

bullets.title: GOOGL: Bearish Hedgeye trend; AI Mode expanding globally but monetization below traditional search
bullets.body: Hedgeye shifted GOOGL to bearish TREND with sell range $279-$324. UBS noted GOOGL 3Q26 actual EPS growth of -5.8% vs. +6.3% expected. Google Cloud grew 103% but Search revenue growth decelerated as AI Mode adoption pressures monetization vs. traditional search. AI Mode ads are expanding globally but at lower per-click economics.

bullets.title: CVX: 3Q26 beat; JPM maintains Overweight; $6B Q4 shareholder return on track
bullets.body: Chevron reported Q3 adjusted EPS of $5.28, beating JPM by 3.7% and Street by 7.3%, with cash flow ex-working capital of $16.6B (+4% vs. JPM). Debt reduced $3B, stock repurchased $2.5B, cash grew $4B sequentially. Upstream production of 3.98 MMBoe/d beat estimates; full-year capex at low end of guidance. CVX expects $6B total shareholder return in Q4 via $2.5-3.0B buybacks and $3.0-3.5B affiliate dividends.

bullets.title: APP: Downgraded to neutral at Edgewater; broader social/ad platform pressure
bullets.body: AppLovin was downgraded to neutral at Edgewater Research from outperform amid broader weakness in the ad tech and social media sector following earnings disappointments at RDDT, PINS, and RBLX. No specific fundamental catalyst cited beyond sector re-rating pressure.
